projectContext: Sprint 10 (rate-limiting) built the 3-tier escalation system: ImpersonationManager, EscalationManager, CookieMethodFallback, RateLimitBudget, RateLimitMetrics, and wired all 8 yt-dlp call sites. Sprint 11 (testing) added unit tests for ImpersonationManager, CookieMethodFallback, compilation modules, and centralized download fixtures. However, several rate-limiting features remain incomplete: preemptive speed-based escalation exists but is never called, adaptive backoff severity multipliers are classified but not applied, per-tier backoff state is not persisted in checkpoints, budget-aware circuit breaker pause scaling is missing, cookie fallback chain doesn't validate files on init, and retry queue + circuit breaker can deadlock. This sprint closes those gaps and adds rate limit window estimation, per-keyword escalation history export, and error-pattern-to-tier correlation tracking to improve escalation intelligence.

userStories.title: Add budget-aware circuit breaker pause scaling
acceptanceCriteria: When circuit breaker trips AND rate_limit_budget.is_nearly_exhausted() (>80% of any resource used), extend pause_seconds by 1.5x
When budget.is_exhausted(), extend pause_seconds by 2.5x (aggressive backoff since no recovery resources remain)
Add is_nearly_exhausted() method to RateLimitBudget that checks if any single resource exceeds 80% usage
Log the pause extension reason: 'Circuit breaker pause extended {original}s -> {extended}s (budget {status})'
Unit test: verify 1.5x extension when budget nearly exhausted, 2.5x when fully exhausted, 1.0x when budget healthy
Unit test: verify pause extension does not exceed max_pause_seconds cap (add max_pause_seconds=300 to CircuitBreakerConfig)

userStories.title: Add cookie fallback chain validation on initialization
acceptanceCriteria: In CookieMethodFallback.__init__(), validate all file-based methods: check file exists and is readable (os.access with R_OK)
Skip invalid file methods during chain construction (log warning per skipped file: 'Cookie file not found, skipping: {path}')
If all file methods invalid, chain degrades to [browser, none] or [none] — never includes broken file entries
Add get_chain_health() method returning dict with total_methods, valid_methods, skipped_files list
Log chain health summary at INFO level on init: 'Cookie fallback chain: {valid}/{total} methods available'
Unit test: construct chain with mix of existing/missing files, verify only valid entries in chain

userStories.title: Fix retry queue and circuit breaker deadlock scenario
acceptanceCriteria: Add max_combined_wait_seconds config to BatchRetryConfig (default: 300) — total wait cap when both CB and cooldown are blocking
When retry queue waits for circuit breaker AND cookie cooldown simultaneously, use min(cb_remaining, cooldown_remaining) + buffer instead of waiting for both sequentially
If max_combined_wait_seconds exceeded, force-process retry queue with current-best cookie method (skip waiting for preferred cookie)
Log deadlock detection: 'Retry queue waited {elapsed}s for CB+cooldown — forcing retry with best-available cookie method'
Unit test: mock both CB open and cookie cooldown active, verify combined wait respects max_combined_wait_seconds
Unit test: verify forced retry uses current best cookie method (not exhausted/cooled-down one)

Calculate estimated_window_seconds as median of (recovery_time - failure_time) across recent pairs (last 10)

Add window estimate to RateLimitMetrics export under 'rate_limiting.estimated_window_seconds'
Add config recommendation: if estimated window > 120s, suggest increasing batch_retry.delay_seconds to match
Unit test: feed alternating failure/success timestamps, verify median calculation correct
